name: Issue
about: Propose a scoped change, report a defect, or improve documentation
title: ""
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

### Summary

What should change, and why.

### State

`draft` / `ready` / `blocked`

A ready issue satisfies the Definition of Ready in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

### Scope

- In scope
- Out of scope

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable behavior
- [ ] Error or refusal path, when one applies
- [ ] Verification command

### Impact

Affected commands, persisted formats, skills, or platform behavior. Write `none` when there is no impact.

### Definition of Ready

- [ ] I searched open and closed issues and open pull requests and found no duplicate.
- [ ] The problem and the desired behavior are stated.
- [ ] The scope is bounded.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are observable.
- [ ] Out-of-scope work is stated.
- [ ] Platform, compatibility, and data-format impact is stated.
